opening_message:
Ticket 1: Ashley Roberts (employee ID E016) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E016.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Ashley Roberts (E016), Analyst, full-time employee. Requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees can have up to write; role does not own Payroll, so admin is not applicable. Requested level (write) is at the allowed maximum — recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E016: contractor with basic security training. Contractors with basic training max out at read; write is not permitted. Recommend read for Payroll (cap to maximum).
reason: The Security agent's record indicates E016 (Ashley Roberts) is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with basic training may have at most read access, and never admin. The requested level (write) exceeds the maximum allowed, so the decision is capped at the maximum: read. Note: the HR agent listed the employee as full-time, but the Security record indicates contractor status with basic training; applying the more restrictive valid maximum, write is not permitted. Grant read.
